purpose: 8번 컷 수정 콘티 — 뱃속이 텅 비었다는 묘사와 원인을 알 수 없다는 묘사 필요

items.prompt:
Create ONE image that is a clean 2x2 grid of FOUR separate, equal-sized vertical 9:16 photographs separated by thin plain white gutters. Shared look: handcrafted miniature / scale-model photography, strong tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical lighting, muted grey-green and brown palette; everything except the giant isopod is a deliberately rough hand-made model. The giant isopod must match the attached replica and real reference images exactly: pale lavender-lilac glossy segmented armour, FLAT dark triangular compound eyes at the front corners of the head, seven pairs of thin legs, spiny fan-shaped tail plate. NEVER draw text, letters, numbers, question marks, labels or logos. No human hands or people.
Panel 1 (top-left): Vertical 9:16 image. Handcrafted miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field. A respectful, schematic cut-away model of a giant isopod (Bathynomus giganteus) made of clay and resin. The outer shell is pale lavender-lilac, while the inside reveals a clearly empty, hollow gut cavity to represent an empty stomach. Warm soft practical light. No text, no labels, no gore, no real organic parts.
Panel 2 (top-right): Vertical 9:16 image. Handcrafted miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field. The giant isopod (Bathynomus giganteus) resting peacefully on a bed of dark velvet. It has pale lavender-lilac glossy segmented armour, flat dark triangular compound eyes, and short antennae. Illuminated by a single warm, soft spotlight from above. No text, no symbols.
Panel 3 (bottom-left): Vertical 9:16 image. Handcrafted miniature diorama photography. A tiny wooden researcher's desk with a blank open notebook and a magnifying glass under a warm desk lamp. No text.
Panel 4 (bottom-right): Vertical 9:16 image. Handcrafted miniature diorama photography. A quiet, empty deep-sea floor made of rough sand and small pebbles, illuminated by a faint warm light.
